what: The pair of files CFM published as release 1 of the tyre-size list snehove-retaze-20261105 (release manifest version 47, 2026-11-15), copied byte for byte. It is the copy the build starts from; while the shop runs, the release manifest brings the pair CFM has published since (src/lib/catalog-release, section tyreSizes).

release.verified: The sha256 and the seal of both files are the ones the live shop reported for the pair it took from the manifest (/api/catalog/status, tyreSizes, state active, source manifest, activatedAt 2026-11-15T21:55:07Z).

velkosti_20261105.json.producer: CFM, backend/apps/products/services/snehove_retaze_velkosti.py (build with the card state and with_pages), run by backend/apps/catalog_pages/publication/tyre_sizes_refresh.py
velkosti_20261105.json.values_source: the sealed batch of 145 snow-chain and snow-sock products (batch id snehove_retaze_produkty_20261105) read with the state of the cards in CFM: the manufacturer's fit list and, for the DAC and Menabo codes, the previous shop's cards. Which sizes have a page of their own (pages, 864) is CFM's decision. Public data only (code, tyre size, rim, tyre condition, source label); no internal CFM id, price or supplier name.

rodiny_20261105.json.values_source: the public code (pn), the family key, the family's brand and line, CFM's own name for a model whose label carries a Slovak noun (name) and the size label printed in the product's name, from the same sealed batch. Which other codes the shop may offer when a code does not fit a size; it decides nothing about fit (the size list does).
